junctions.neck: intentional open boundary64 for head weld
junctions.membranes: separate thickened editable overlays at interdigital roots

limits: Ankle32 triangle transitions per side and small digit-tip caps remain candidates for manual retopology.
Separate membranes need pose-specific collision/weight review.
A predominantly quad cage is not proof of final deformation quality.

eyelid_fit.method: All facial skin over projected globe ellipse fitted to safety shell; inner aperture wall excluded.

limits: Ear roots are separate anatomical surfaces overlapping lateral skull, not welded.
Iris and pupil are open thin caps on the globe, not closed independent spheres.
Oral cavity has a small triangle fan behind lip surface; facial skin annuli are quads.
Neutral study has no facial expression rig or final facial retopology approval.

membrane_weights: Hands: bilinear blend of the two adjacent digits, max4 normalized influences. Feet: foot/toe collective blend.
neutral_material: No texture, vertex color, metallic or emissive inputs
